name: Stablecoin supply regime gate on a BTC/ETH trend sleeve (mcap-expanding = risk-on)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM: aggregate stablecoin_mcap expansion vs contraction is the cleanest risk-appetite regime axis in crypto (2025 Q3 saw +$45B, the largest ever = risk-on; Q4 collapsed to +$8B during a 22% crypto-backed-stable contraction = risk-off). Contracting stable supply means capital physically leaving the perimeter (redemptions to fiat), which precedes/accompanies de-risking. This is a FILTER, not a standalone alpha: stablecoin_mcap growth positive GATES when a simple trend-follow (positive medium-term ret_Nd + ADX confirming a real trend) is allowed to be long. The edge is avoiding drawdown regimes, not out-predicting a counterparty. Exit on trend death (ADX collapse). DISCONFIRMER 1: the gate must IMPROVE DSR and CUT maxDD vs the ungated trend sleeve — if it only reduces trade count without improving risk-adjusted return it is a curve-fit filter and dies. DISCONFIRMER 2: mcap is smooth/laggy -> KILL if it flips too slowly to matter and whipsaws at turns. DISCONFIRMER 3: if a plain price-vol / 200d-MA regime filter does the same job, the on-chain feature is redundant. Net of fees.
catalyst: expanding stablecoin supply gating a long trend sleeve
